# WyNotify

WyNotify is a simple customer notification platform for businesses, website owners and app owners.

## What it does
- Collects opted-in notification subscribers.
- Sends customer updates, promotions, announcements and alerts.
- Provides subscriber counts and delivery results.
- Supports website and app integrations through developer SDK/API tools.
- Keeps the everyday experience focused on business owners rather than infrastructure.

## Main workflow
Connect a website or app -> collect subscribers -> send notifications -> review delivery results.

## Developer resources
The dashboard includes registration credentials, SDK examples, API endpoints and integration guidance under Advanced tools.

## Important
WyNotify should only be used to send notifications to users who have voluntarily granted notification permission or otherwise legitimately opted in.
